brief.prompt: Create a 7-slide cinematic decision story for engineering and product leaders. Show how agent-generated presentations cross from plausible output to trusted production delivery. Use a guarded threshold as a continuous visual metaphor; begin with exposed uncertainty, reveal the hidden failure cascade, prove the controlled generate-publish-export path with an editable architecture diagram and an evidence chart using values 53, 17, and 2, climax at the production gate, then resolve with one owned action. Vary composition deliberately and keep all visible copy concise.

elements.name: Story continuity · threshold line

elements.content: Agent-generated decks cross a threshold from impressive draft to trusted deliverable. Unguarded, that crossing is a leap of faith.
elements.name: Body copy

elements.content: •  Unverified content risks silent errors in leadership decks
elements.name: Key point 1

elements.content: •  Export failures surface only after distribution begins
elements.name: Key point 2

elements.content: •  Approval requires evidence, not just eloquence
elements.name: Key point 3

elements.altText: threshold line 2: tension; emotional intensity 39 of 100
elements.name: Story continuity · threshold line

elements.content: One unverified artifact triggers a cascade: structural rewrites, misaligned data, and export failures that erode trust at the worst moment.
elements.name: Body copy

elements.content: 01  Routine volume hides the rare catastrophic failure
elements.name: Key point 1

elements.content: 02  Late discovery means fixes happen after stakeholders see drafts
elements.name: Key point 2

elements.content: 03  A guard at the threshold interrupts the cascade before delivery
elements.name: Key point 3

elements.altText: threshold line 3: hint; emotional intensity 54 of 100
elements.name: Story continuity · threshold line

elements.content: NodeSlide inserts a guarded checkpoint between generation and publication, validating every typed artifact before the threshold opens.
elements.name: Body copy

elements.content: 01  Typed artifacts enforce structure before styling
elements.name: Key point 1

elements.content: 03  Rejections route back to generation with diagnostics
elements.name: Key point 3

elements.altText: threshold line 4: reveal; emotional intensity 70 of 100
elements.name: Story continuity · threshold line

elements.content: Production runs show the volume the gate processes, the exceptions it corrects, and the critical failures it blocks before export.

elements.content: 03  2 critical failures blocked at the export boundary
elements.name: Key point 3

elements.altText: threshold line 5: prove; emotional intensity 85 of 100
elements.name: Story continuity · threshold line

elements.content: The steep drop-off from routine validations to critical blocks shows the gate filtering effectively: volume handled early, catastrophe stopped last.

elements.name: Key point 3

elements.content: At the gate, the threshold transforms from risk boundary to controlled checkpoint. Only typed, provenance-backed artifacts may pass.

elements.content: 03  The gate opens only when validation is complete
